PUNJAB MEDIUM-TERM FISCAL FRAMEWORK
AND BUDGET STRATEGY RULES, 2023
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
19th April, 2023]
No.SO(P&R)
5-2/2022, dated 12.4.2023.---In
exercise of the powers conferred under section 48 of the Punjab Public
Financial Management Act 2022 (XXXVII of 2022), Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make the following rules:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1)
These rules may be cited as the Punjab Medium-term Fiscal Framework and Budget
Strategy Rules, 2023.
(2) They
shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.---(1) In the rules, unless the subject or context
requires otherwise:
(a) "Act"
means the Punjab Public Financial Management Act, 2022 (XXXVII of 2022);
(b) "Budget
Strategy" means the Medium-term planning of the Government with respect to
inflows of financial resources and subsequent allocation thereof;
(c) "Budget
Strategy Paper" means the document that covers the Budget Strategy;
(d) "Federal
Divisible Pool" means pool of taxes levied and collected by the Federal
Government including but not limited to taxes on income, sales, excise duties,
custom duties, wealth and capital value etc.;
(e) "Fiscal
Discipline Committee" means a Committee notified by the Finance
Department;
(f) "Joint
Priorities Committee" means a Committee notified by the Finance
Department;
(g) "Medium-term
Fiscal Framework" means forecast of receipts and expenditure based on
certain economic assumptions to act as a guide for taking corrective measures
to ensure fiscal discipline during the period-of-interest;
(h) "period-of-interest"
means ongoing fiscal year (baseline year) and three outer years (next fiscal
year as budget year and the two subsequent fiscal years);
(i) "Resource
Mobilization Committee" means the Committee notified by the Finance
Department;
(j) "rules"
means the Punjab Medium-term Fiscal Framework and Budget Strategy Rules, 2023;
and
(k) "single
ceiling" means single budgetary threshold to meet current and development
expenditure.
(2) A
word or expression used but not defined in the rules shall have the same
meaning as assigned to it in the Act.
3. Preparation,
submission and approval of Medium-term Fiscal Framework and Budget Strategy.---The Medium-term Fiscal Framework, for each
fiscal year, shall be prepared consistent with the medium-term national macro
fiscal framework, in terms of the national targets for revenues, expenditures
and primary balances for the period -of-interest and the procedure given below:
(a) the
Fiscal Discipline Committee shall review the estimates of Medium-term Fiscal
Framework finalized during last fiscal year before the period-of-interest on
the basis of revenue and expenditure results reported in Civil Accounts of
first quarter of ongoing fiscal year as prepared by the Accountant-General
Punjab;
(b) the
Fiscal Discipline Committee shall revise ongoing fiscal year's estimates of
expenditure and revenue based on first quarter results and macro-variables of
the Federal Government actualized by the close of last fiscal year;
(c) preliminary
Medium-term Fiscal Framework and Budget Strategy for the period-of-interest
shall be prepared as per the output mentioned in clause (b) and potential
budget priorities for the upcoming budget;
(d) the
Finance Secretary shall approve preliminary Medium-term Fiscal Framework and
Budget Strategy duly recommended by the Fiscal Discipline Committee;
(e) the
Joint Priorities Committee shall set indicative single ceilings of the
Departments on the basis of approved preliminary Medium-term Fiscal Framework
and Budget Strategy estimates;
(f) the
Departments shall submit budgetary proposals as per clause (e) for evaluation
and recommendation of allocation by the Joint Priorities Committee;

Finance Department, on recommendation of the Resource Mobilization Committee,
